notes: Cliopatria has no British Kaffraria. The dossier covers only 1860-1866 (a separate Crown colony); before that the area was Cape land from 17 December 1847 ('the area was again seized by the new British Governor Harry Smith') and, in 1835-36, the Queen Adelaide Province (all in the Cape dossier). The page's infobox says 'Established: 1835', the lead 1847: unreconciled. Also: Xhosa cattle-killing 1856-57, German settlers 1858-59 and 1877-78. King William's Town point is the researcher's own. Gazetteer region British Kaffraria is used by the Cape dossier too.
